The '''Vestar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vestar/Legends|Vestar]].
